name: Novotel Auckland Airport
description: The only hotel directly connected to Auckland Airport by covered walkway — Novotel Auckland Airport is a premium 4-star hotel ideal for visitors combining a Rainbow's End trip with Auckland arrival or departure. Features comfortable rooms, a pool, gym and multiple dining options. 20 minutes from Rainbow's End.
